module TopModule(input clk, input a, input b, output reg q, output reg state);
  reg [1:0] p;
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    p <= {a, b};
    case (p)
      2'b00: begin q <= 1; state <= 1; end
      2'b01: begin q <= 0; state <= 0; end
      2'b10: begin q <= 0; state <= 0; end
      2'b11: begin q <= 1; state <= 0; end
    endcase
  end
endmodule
